After n years:
- Total revenue = n × $151,917
- Total costs = $119 (initial) + n × $764 (annual maintenance)
- Net profit = n × $151,917 - $119 - n × $764
- Net profit = n × ($151,917 - $764) - $119
- Net profit = n × $151,153 - $119

n × $151,153 - $119 > 0
n × $151,153 > $119
n > $119 ÷ $151,153

- Total costs: $119 + $764 = $883
- Net profit: $151,917 - $883 = $151,034
